overview.title: MCP
overview.summary: The agent-facing MCP surface in Igris. One endpoint, a fixed strict-schema tool set, always scoped to the tenant behind the credential: discover registered actions, call them, and inspect the resulting runs, evidence, and runtimes.

guides.title: Overview
guides.summary: What MCP does in Igris, where it fits in the product, and which transport surfaces expose it.

guides.title: MCP Server
guides.summary: The product-facing MCP server contract, JSON-RPC request shape, and core method families.

guides.title: MCP Swarm Mode
guides.summary: How shared context replication works across multiple runtimes and where its design boundaries are.

guides.title: MCP Integration Patterns
guides.summary: How to use MCP in production without confusing shared context, durable progress, and audit evidence.

methodGroups.title: Transport Surface
methodGroups.summary: The single production route that carries MCP traffic.

methods.name: POST /v1/mcp
methods.summary: Request/response JSON-RPC transport for MCP calls, scoped to the authenticated tenant.

methodGroups.title: JSON-RPC Methods
methodGroups.summary: Methods for discovery and invocation of the fixed MCP tool set. Tool schemas are strict and unknown fields are rejected.

methods.name: tools/list
methods.summary: List the available tools and their strict input schemas.

methods.name: tools/call
methods.summary: Call one tool by name with arguments matching its schema.

methodGroups.title: Tools
methodGroups.summary: The fixed tool set exposed through tools/call. There are no context/* or resource/* methods.

methods.name: get_action
methods.summary: Get one registered action by id or name.

methods.name: call_action
methods.summary: Run a registered action. Supports an idempotency key for safe retries.

methods.name: list_runs
methods.summary: List recent runs for the tenant.

methods.name: get_run
methods.summary: Inspect one run: status, policy state, runtime assignment, and proof state.

methods.name: get_run_evidence
methods.summary: Read the safe evidence summary for a run: step digests, proof status, and receipt presence.

methods.name: list_runtimes
methods.summary: List the tenant's registered runtimes and whether they are currently routable.
